{"answers":[{"question_id":"Q010_rossmann_family_function_divergence","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08 these are three distinct families—alcohol-dehydrogenase-like C-terminal domains c.2.1.1 (SUNID 51736), CoA-binding domains c.2.1.8 (SUNID 51900), and potassium-channel NAD-binding domains c.2.1.9 (SUNID 63944)—within the same NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold superfamily c.2.1 (SUNID 51735), Rossmann fold c.2, and α/β class c. Their shared superfamily supports remote common ancestry, which is stronger than mere fold resemblance; their different family assignments indicate substantial divergence and do not negate that homology. These names describe classified domains, not whole proteins or every protein that binds CoA, NAD, or participates in a potassium channel: in particular, c.2.1.9 is a soluble channel-associated regulatory domain, not the membrane pore, and c.2.1.1 is only the C-terminal Rossmann-like domain. SCOPe additionally notes that the N-terminal all-β domain helps define the alcohol-dehydrogenase-like family, so domain architecture matters. It is unsafe to transfer alcohol-dehydrogenase catalysis, CoA binding, NAD binding, or channel regulation across the three families from the common superfamily alone. For functional annotation, require family-level sequence/profile evidence plus conserved ligand-binding and catalytic residues, domain architecture, structural comparison, and appropriate biochemical evidence—binding or enzymology for the first two and electrophysiology/regulatory evidence for channel-associated proteins. Prefer a high-quality, boundary-matched representative or template from the same family and comparable multidomain context; a cross-family c.2.1 template may model the conserved Rossmann α/β core but is unreliable for loops, pockets, interfaces, ligand specificity, or function.","evidence_used":["search_scop — /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=alcohol+dehydrogenase&mode=token&limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=CoA+binding&mode=token&limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=potassium+channel&mode=token&limit=50","get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/homology","get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/homology","get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/homology","get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735/homology"]}]}
